profile.headline: Software Development Manager at Neon One
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with a passion for problem solving and learning. I have extensive experience working in cross-functional teams, and collaborating across business units to develop solutions to improve internal processes, customer experience, and information quality.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
• Develop highly testable, scalable, and performant RESTful microservices with an emphasis on stability and supportability by writing readable code, high quality unit/integration tests, and thoughtful log messages
• Automate the ingestion of critical store and customer data from multiple APIs and transform it for 
consumption by data warehouses in a highly fault-tolerant manner
• Build subject matter expertise in various business domains. Leverage this to improve delivery speed and accuracy by identifying missing requirements or functionality gaps early in the planning phase of features
• Provide timely support to stores when production issues arise. Work with other service teams to triage issues and provide mitigation strategies, resolution estimates, and RCAs to incident managers
• Perform code reviews and provide feedback to peers to ensure excellent code coverage and coding standards are upheld in our services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborate with Product, QA, and other Development team members to develop and deliver features with appropriate test coverage in an agile environment
• Propose and implement solutions to modernize pieces of highly customized legacy code in order to improve overall product stability, scalability, and user experience
• Create and contribute to web services to facilitate data exchange between our web application and payment gateways, external data providers for our clients, and our mobile application
• Conduct bi-weekly releases. Deploy release packages to staging, pre-live, and production environments
• Serve as a point of contact for offshore and more junior team members for training, code reviews, and 
alignment on best practices

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Use technologies such as C#, .NET web frameworks, T-SQL, Vue.js, and TFS to accomplish daily tasks.
• Build web applications to provide internal teams with a way to explore, export, and interact with data from Data Warehouse in a safe, user/role-specific manner.
• Assist in maintaining data warehouse for reporting and internal applications/tools. Tasks include ensuring data accuracy and optimizing the ETL process.
• Develop client libraries to access supplier web services at regular intervals to ensure data is up to date.
• Rebuilt Yardi Marketplace client registration system to considerably reduce onboarding time and time required by operations team members to process applications.
• Developed a reporting tool for analysts to autonomously schedule, design, and deliver dynamic reports to internal and external clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with a small, cross-functional team to begin migration of a legacy application to a microservices architecture
• Gained experience working with the Agile SDLC methodology as a developer
• Gained experience with Test Driven Development
• Researched various testing and REST API frameworks to implement, and regularly reported findings and recommendations to team members

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
• Created and maintained automation suites using TestComplete scripts to increase efficiency, and allow for more time spent on manual exploratory testing
• Gained a strong understanding of the Agile SDLC methodology in a QA role
• Developed test cases and defect tracking reports to provide to product managers and other key stakeholders

positions.title: Systems Support Intern
positions.description:
• Utilize SQL, Excel, and Visual Studio to build custom reports using contact center data to drive decisions throughout the business. 
• Collaborate with team members to prepare and present consistent, timely, and accurate insights to department leaders.
• Govern incoming data, and validate the correctness of internal and external reports. 
• Support mobile app launch by providing solutions to restaurant and customer facing challenges.
